blocks.title: French Data Protection Act of 6 January 1978
blocks.text:
In accordance with French law no. 78-17 of 6 January 1978, you may at any time access the personal information held about you and ask for it to be corrected or deleted.
You can exercise this right by sending a message through the site’s contact form, stating the fields and/or information you want changed.

blocks.title: Collection of personal information
blocks.text: Under the French Data Protection Act of 6 January 1978, personal data collected from visitors through a form or otherwise will under no circumstances be passed on, free of charge or for payment, to third parties, whether individuals or companies.

blocks.title: User responsibility
blocks.text:
Users undertake to use the services offered on the site fairly and honestly, and for their intended purpose.
Users undertake to use the services offered on the site for their own needs only and not to trade them with third parties.

blocks.title: Databases
blocks.text:
All information about members shown on the site, and the way it is consulted, make up the site’s databases. They are the exclusive property of the publication director and are protected by the French Intellectual Property Code and by the European directive of 11 March 1996 on the legal protection of databases.
Users therefore undertake to use this data strictly within the services offered on the site and in particular not to reproduce, translate, adapt, arrange, transform, communicate, represent or distribute all or part of it, permanently or temporarily, by any means and in any form.
Any use in breach of these conditions infringes the rights of the publication director and is punishable under international conventions and copyright rules. The publication director, as producer of the databases, prohibits the extraction and reuse of all or any part of their content.
The publication director takes all necessary measures to prevent theft, harmful use or destruction of the site’s databases, but cannot protect users against such offences if they are caused by the host failing in its obligations.

blocks.title: Links to the site
blocks.text:
Any hyperlink from another site to this site requires the express prior authorisation of the publication director. Link requests should be sent through the site’s contact form.
The information on this website is provided by the publication director and is protected. Distributing, modifying or reproducing all or part of this site is prohibited without prior written consent from the publication director.

blocks.title: Site assistant
blocks.text: The site assistant answers from the site’s pages and documents. It only uses Google’s Gemini API if the visitor has accepted it in the cookie banner. Its answers are not contractual: for any booking, the team calls you back.
